note: The original description (Tsai & Huang 1979) could not be obtained; the entry is compiled from the species-level account and measurement table in the Isoptera volume of Fauna Sinica, soldier only.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, nasus black, anterior margin of the pronotum yellowish brown. Head bare, the tip of the nasus sparsely covered with small hairs, the anterior margin of the pronotum occasionally with small hairs, the abdominal tergites and sternites sparsely covered with fine hairs. Head pear-shaped, the tip of the nasus slender, head wider than long, widest in the middle, the posterior margin slightly flat; in lateral view the nasus slightly concave, its tip slightly upturned, without an elevation at the base; fontanelle duct distinct, reaching the anterior middle of the head; labrum wider than long, the anterior margin arcuate in the middle. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 larger than segment 2 or equal to segment 4; mandibles massive, the anterior margin slightly curved, with 1 sharp apical spine on the outer side. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the abdominal tergites weakly sclerotized. Measurements (mm, mean in parentheses): body length 4.43—4.72 (4.57); head length including nasus 1.89—2.00 (1.96); nasus length 0.96—1.07 (1.04); head height 0.75—0.89 (0.82); head width 1.07—1.25 (1.18); pronotum length 0.21—0.25 (0.21); pronotum width 0.54—0.61 (0.54); hind tibia length 1.07—1.25 (1.15).

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Distribution: Medog (Yazang), Xizang, at 1000 m altitude. Original description in Tsai & Huang 1979, Acta Entomologica Sinica 22(3): 336—342.
